instruction: Set DuckDuckGo as the default search engine in Chrome settings.

metadata.explanation: Task requires agent to navigate to Chrome search engine settings and change the default search engine to DuckDuckGo. Evaluator verifies by checking the Chrome Preferences file default_search_provider_data.template_url_data.short_name field. The existing getter function get_default_search_engine is reused.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts the default search engine name from Chrome Preferences file at the correct path: default_search_provider_data.template_url_data.short_name
Metric function (exact_match) appropriately compares the extracted search engine name with expected value 'DuckDuckGo'
Postconfig correctly restarts Chrome to ensure Preferences file is written to disk with any changes made during task execution
Evaluator provides complete coverage of the instruction requirement (setting DuckDuckGo as default search engine)
Getter has robust error handling with fallback to 'Google', which will correctly fail evaluation on errors
Cross-platform support properly implemented for Windows, macOS, and Linux (including ARM)
